target.work: E. Fermi, J. Pasta, S. Ulam (with M. Tsingou), Studies of Nonlinear Problems, I

expected_output.observable: energy of modes 1 through 5 versus cycle
expected_output.cycle_axis: computational cycles; one cycle is one integration time step

units.mass: unit mass at every interior site
units.time: dimensionless model time; reported abscissa is cycle count

mode_analysis.nonlinear_energy_note: The plotted modal energy omits the nonlinear potential contribution, as in the report; the omission is expected to be at most a few percent.

integrator.name: explicit central-difference (Stormer-Verlet)
integrator.implementation_assumption: The report's statement that derivatives were replaced by difference expressions is reconstructed as a position-space Störmer–Verlet / velocity-Verlet update; no author code is available.
startup_step: Compute a(x^0) from the stated initial displacement and fixed boundaries.
Drift: x^1=x^0 + dt*v^(1/2), then recompute a(x^1).
Complete the first step with v^1=v^(1/2)+(dt/2)*a(x^1).
subsequent_step: Recompute acceleration and complete the kick v^(n+1)=v^(n+1/2)+(dt/2)*a(x^(n+1)).
integrator.equivalent_position_form: x^(n+1)=2*x^n-x^(n-1)+dt^2*a(x^n) after the explicit first step
integrator.boundary_update: x_0 and x_N remain zero at every force evaluation

numerics.seeds: none; deterministic initial state and arithmetic

solver_settings.force_evaluations: one at each position update plus the startup evaluation
solver_settings.tolerance: not an iterative solver; no residual tolerance
solver_settings.overflow_policy: non-finite state is a failed run

compute_envelope.measurement: A throwaway float64 throughput probe on 2026-09-12 took 0.34 s for 30,000 iterations of the 32-site force/update shape; the later runner must measure and record its own runtime.
compute_envelope.memory_expectation: less than 256 MiB; streamed samples plus bounded state
compute_envelope.reproducibility: record host, Python version, package lock hash, git revision, input hashes, wall-clock start/end, and exit status

input_selection.input_sha256_recording: The runner records the CSV SHA-256 in run.json.
input_selection.preprocessing: Read the header and the named feature rows; use the digitized values only as references and do not infer or tune model parameters from the plotted curves.
input_selection.source_payload_policy: The LA-1940 PDF is fetched from the public URL into a temporary path; no PDF payload is tracked.

M1.name: first mode-1 recurrence time
M1.definition: argmax of E_1 over cycles 20000 through 30000
M1.reference: mode-1 first recurrence maximum t_cycles in fig1-digitized.csv

M3.name: global maxima of modes 2, 3, and 4
M3.definition: time and height of the global maximum of each of modes 2, 3, and 4 over cycles 0 through 20,000 (the labelled major peaks in the figure)

tolerance.time: within 5 percent of the digitized time
tolerance.height: within 10 percent of E_1(0), using the report-axis normalization

additional_reporting.mode5_first_major_peak: reported, not gated: global maximum of mode 5 over cycles 0-20,000, compared with the mode-5 first-maximum row.
additional_reporting.mode3_second_maximum: reported, not gated: global maximum of mode 3 over the window from just after its first (gated) maximum through cycle 20,000, compared with the mode-3 second-maximum row (~19k cycles).

amendment.reason: v1's 'first local maximum' definition caught sub-1% early bumps (v1 measured mode 2's first local maximum at t=200 cycles, 0.7 units) instead of the labelled major peak the figure and report text describe. Observed only after running v1's baseline on 2026-09-12; the tolerances themselves (5 percent time, 10 percent height) are unchanged.

M4.name: higher-mode ceiling (per mode)
M4.definition: max over cycles 0-30,000 and over modes 6 through 31 of the single-mode energy
M4.reference: caption ceiling 20/300 of E_1(0), applied per mode

additional_reporting.summed_modes_6_31_max: reported for transparency: max over cycles of the summed energy of modes 6-31 (the v1 definition).

amendment.reason: The caption 'the higher modes never exceeded in energy 20 of our units' describes an individual-mode ceiling, not a sum; v1 summed modes 6-31 (measured 25.4 units for the sum), misreading the caption. Observed only after running v1's baseline on 2026-09-12; the threshold value (20/300) is unchanged.

C1.name: linear-chain control
C1.definition: Set alpha=0 and verify E_1 remains within 1 percent of its initial value over 10000 cycles.

C2.name: full-energy conservation
C2.definition: Include the quadratic and cubic spring potential terms and measure maximum relative total-energy drift over the 30000-cycle baseline.

C3.name: time-step convergence
C3.definition: Repeat with dt/2 while holding physical elapsed time fixed, and compare the recurrence time after converting both runs to physical time.

amendment.reason: v1 measured a 5.1 percent shift of t_rec when halving dt, above the unchanged 1 percent threshold. The reproduction target is the MANIAC computation at its own step (dt^2=1/8), so continuum convergence is not a precondition for reproducing the paper's figure; the sensitivity is a real, scientifically meaningful finding that must stay visible rather than gate execution status. Observed only after running v1's baseline on 2026-09-12; the definition and 1 percent threshold are unchanged, only whether a failure flips the overall execution status.

decision_rules.failed_control: Any failed gating control (C1 or C2) makes the execution status 'failed control'; retain metrics and diagnostics. C3 is a reported sensitivity check: its own pass/fail is retained but never flips the execution status.
decision_rules.discrepancy: M1 outside its tolerance is a 'discrepancy'; retain it and do not tune the baseline to the figure.
decision_rules.inconclusive: Use 'inconclusive' when required metrics or controls cannot be evaluated, when the reference feature is ambiguous beyond its stated uncertainty, or when the result does not decide the kill condition.
decision_rules.amendment: A changed method requires a new protocol/v3.json and protocol/v3.md with a dated reason. protocol/v2.json and protocol/v2.md are frozen and must never be edited after this task lands; protocol/v1.json and protocol/v1.md remain frozen from the prior task.

changelog.change: v2: corrected mode labels of the digitized reference; normative metrics, tolerances, parameters and integrator unchanged.

M3 redefined from 'first local maximum' to 'global maximum of modes 2, 3, and 4 over cycles 0-20,000'; tolerances unchanged. Now additionally reports mode 5's first major peak and mode 3's second maximum with their residuals.
changelog.reason: v1's definition caught a sub-1% early bump instead of the labelled major peak; a specification error found by running v1's baseline, not a change to the numerics or the tolerances.

changelog.change: M4 redefined from 'max over cycles of the summed energy of modes 6-31' to 'max over cycles and modes 6..31 of the single-mode energy'; threshold unchanged at 20/300 of E_1(0). The summed value is still reported for transparency.
changelog.reason: The caption states an individual-mode ceiling; v1 misread it as a sum. A specification error found by running v1's baseline, not a change to the numerics or the threshold.

changelog.change: C3 keeps its definition and 1 percent threshold, but a C3 failure no longer flips the run's overall execution status; C3 is reported as a sensitivity check alongside the gating controls C1 and C2.
changelog.reason: v1 measured a real 5.1% dt/2 sensitivity in t_rec. The paper's recurrence time is a property of the discretised chain at its own step, so this sensitivity should stay visible without being conflated with the report's own reproducibility, which does not depend on continuum convergence.
